title: Power headroom publishes 0 kW all off-season under a `> 0.0` -> `>= 0.0` mutant, and no check notices
claim: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._power_headroom (coordinator.py:8900) may be weakened from `sample_factor(now) > 0.0` to `>= 0.0` and the full gate passes; sample_factor is clamped to [0, 1], so the mutant takes the capacity branch whenever the tariff is enabled: for a fuse-less install with a Nov-Mar capacity tariff, in July the baseline publishes unavailable while the mutant publishes 0.0 kW headroom (probe), which a charger automation reads as 'draw nothing'.
